run_modular_addition_training: run the modular addition neural network training loop with hydra config and save model checkpoints
generate_modular_addition_dataset: generate a modular addition dataset with all x, y pairs for a given modulus M
test_modular_addition_model: test the ModularAdditionNN model on a test set and return per-output accuracy and loss
compute_modular_addition_loss: compute nll or mse loss between model outputs and labels for modular addition tasks
normalize_modular_addition_weights: normalize the layera, layerb, and layerc weights of ModularAdditionNN by subtracting their means
